generatedFrom.sourceDescription: Weekly Broadway grosses (Playbill), 1985-2020, via the TidyTuesday project. Real shows, theatres, seat counts, capacity and ticket prices.

modelled: Individual orders are modelled, not real: the source data is weekly and aggregate. Each show plays its real eight-performance week at its real weekly capacity; this platform sells `share` of the house and splits those seats into orders across sections, channels, promos and party sizes, priced off the show's real average ticket price.
